bridgeRouteRisk.summary: tGBP has issuer-native StableTokenV1OFT deployments on Ethereum, Base, BSC, Polygon, Avalanche, Arbitrum, and Gnosis plus an issuer-native Solana SPL mint. LayerZero V2 supplies a separate direct OFT burn/mint mesh: EVM owners configure peers and bridge options, while the Solana OFT Store 9hbekmg6j6YFpuYcDoJJovndnNkBaVayzKZuAWaX6dLb is one signer of the 1-of-2 mint multisig for inbound bridge credits. The shared EVM owner can mint, pause, configure OFT peers, and authorize upgrades without a verified immutable numeric ceiling, so its bridge cap semantics are conservatively raiseable. Recent LayerZero Scan observations show V302, ten confirmations, three required DVNs, and route-specific executors; the OFT route is therefore externally validated, while direct native minting remains independently scored under Mint Authority.

controls.label: tGBP EVM LayerZero OFT owner bridge controls

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: LayerZero V2 direct OFT burn/mint: source transfers debit or burn tGBP and destination transfers credit or mint tGBP. No independent lockbox or escrow was identified.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: All seven EVM StableTokenV1OFT deployments use Endpoint V2 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fe728c and current nonzero peers to the other authored EVM deployments plus the Solana OFT Store 9hbekmg6j6YFpuYcDoJJovndnNkBaVayzKZuAWaX6dLb; the owner can replace setPeer configuration and enforced options.
routeChecks.attestorQuorum: LayerZero Scan observations show V302 with ten confirmations, three required DVNs (LayerZero Labs, Nethermind, and Google), no optional DVNs, no optional threshold, and route-specific executors. The active route is externally validated by this DVN stack.
routeChecks.rateLimits: Exact live remaining token-specific route quotas were not available from the reviewed OFT interfaces; the LayerZero Scan observations provide active DVN and executor configuration, not those remaining quotas.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The common issuer EOA controls owner-only bridge surfaces including setPeer, enforced options, Endpoint delegate/OApp configuration, pause/unpause, and upgrade surfaces on the seven EVM OFT deployments. These bridge capabilities are separate from its native owner-only mint/burn capability.
routeChecks.signingModel: The EVM bridge controller is the issuer EOA 0xAF4fCE2984Fb307a368f3Ff01f900909956595C0; no Safe, timelock, module, guard, or delay was verified.

controls.capDescription: No aggregate bridge mint cap was verified; OFT route-level conservation is supplied by source debit/burn and destination credit/mint, not by a native issuance cap.
controls.evidence: At the 2026-08-16 observations (Ethereum block 25771292, Base 50069042, BSC 116370461, Polygon 92148275, Avalanche 92987083, Arbitrum 495314108, and Gnosis 47763307), owner() on every authored EVM StableTokenV1OFT returned issuer EOA 0xAF4fCE2984Fb307a368f3Ff01f900909956595C0 and endpoint() returned LayerZero Endpoint V2 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fe728c. Current peers bind the EVM deployments to one another and to the Solana OFT Store. The owner's setPeer, enforced-options, endpoint delegate/OApp, pause, and upgrade surfaces are bridge machinery; native direct mint/burn remains separately authored in Mint Authority. A recent Solana-to-Ethereum LayerZero message delivered on Ethereum block 25753011 used ULN V302, ten confirmations, required LayerZero Labs, Nethermind, and Google DVNs, no optional DVNs or optional threshold, and a route-specific executor.

controls.label: tGBP Solana OFT destination mint-authority multisig

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: LayerZero Solana OFT credit is a direct bridge burn/mint route; no independent lockbox or escrow was identified.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: At Solana slot 439747729, the 1-of-2 SPL Token Program multisig signers were the LayerZero OFT Store 9hbekmg6j6YFpuYcDoJJovndnNkBaVayzKZuAWaX6dLb and an additional issuer signer. The Store is the route-bound bridge signer; the second signer means the token-level authority also remains a native issuer control.
routeChecks.caps: No numeric SPL mint or bridge route cap was verified. Because the multisig threshold is 1, the Store can participate in inbound bridge credit minting; the additional issuer signer is a separate token-level mint surface outside the LayerZero route.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The multisig is both the native Solana mint/freeze authority and a bridge boundary. Its native direct mint capability remains in Mint Authority; this control scores only the Store-backed bridge mint capability.

controls.capDescription: No numeric SPL mint cap was verified; the 1-of-2 authority can authorize bridge credits without an on-chain amount ceiling.
bypassSurfaces: The additional issuer signer can participate in SPL Token Program minting outside LayerZero route validation; operational separation from bridge credits is not proven.
controls.evidence: At Solana slot 439747729 on 2026-08-16, the tGBP SPL mint had mint and freeze authority 3NsEdxXZX6QXNtZT2prWQF2c8VFznc9zK1A2BjzAMyjs, an initialized 1-of-2 Token Program multisig. Its signers were the LayerZero OFT Store 9hbekmg6j6YFpuYcDoJJovndnNkBaVayzKZuAWaX6dLb and the additional issuer signer DN5dhdTVSbTenTb7fPDFWhbfwFsAUBCAogA1kEAxB3Qn. The Store's bridge signing power is scored here, while the same multisig's native issuer mint ability remains in Mint Authority.

controls.label: tGBP Solana OFT Store bridge state and signer

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: The Solana OFT Store participates in LayerZero direct burn/mint accounting; no independent lockbox or escrow was identified.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: The Store account is owned by LayerZero OFT program GWJaQfjcxxEqmrYME74bPVfyueN4wWrB14CNyfRZcXNY. LayerZero's Solana account model places remote peers and enforced options in PeerConfig accounts owned by the Store's bridge state.
routeChecks.rateLimits: LayerZero's Solana OFT account model includes route rate limiters and fee settings in bridge state. Exact live remaining tGBP quotas were not available from the reviewed interfaces.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The Store is one signer of the 1-of-2 SPL mint-authority multisig, so it can participate in inbound bridge credit authorization; the separate OFT program upgrade authority is scored in tgbp-solana-oft-program-upgrade-authority.

controls.capDescription: No numeric route cap was verified; the Store is a bridge-state controller and one signer of the token's 1-of-2 mint-authority multisig.
controls.evidence: At Solana slot 439748066 on 2026-08-16, OFT Store 9hbekmg6j6YFpuYcDoJJovndnNkBaVayzKZuAWaX6dLb was owned by LayerZero OFT program GWJaQfjcxxEqmrYME74bPVfyueN4wWrB14CNyfRZcXNY and was the bridge signer in the tGBP 1-of-2 mint-authority multisig. The Store's PeerConfig, enforced-option, rate-limit, and fee-setting boundary is bridge machinery and remains separate from the native issuer mint control.
